name: PBQtah 7 2024
information:
# **This competition is not recommended for first time competitors**

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. 

Go to our link tree to find links to our Facebook group, Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!
